ideas.pitch: A solo developer productivity and streak analytics dashboard tailored for the 21-day Code Quest challenge, featuring automated problem submission tracking and speed benchmarks.
ideas.title: CodeQuest Tracker & Async Progress Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the 21-day consistency and speed theme of the event, targeting the solo-developer format where tracking personal metrics is highly practical.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered local knowledge base and interactive assistant that indexes competitive programming editorials, algorithms, and complexity analyses to provide targeted hints without spoiling full solutions.
ideas.title: CP-RAG Doubt Resolver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent RAG patterns proven in recent hackathon wins to solve the explicit 'doubt-solving & discussions' feature highlighted in the challenge description.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web utility that parses submitted code snippets, builds an abstract syntax tree estimate of the time complexity, and renders live execution step counters for test cases.
ideas.title: Algorithmic Complexity Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a genuinely hard engineering problem in code analysis that stands out to judges evaluating technical depth in a competitive coding event.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight sandboxed execution runner designed to test and benchmark identical competitive programming solutions across Python, C++, and Rust for execution speed and memory footprints.
ideas.title: Multi-Language CP Benchmark Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous performance benchmarking similar to winning forecasting and risk detection platforms, emphasizing raw execution metrics.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent platform that analyzes a competitor's solved problems over the 21-day challenge and automatically constructs a personalized knowledge gap graph and mock interview question set.
ideas.title: CP Skill Graph & Interview Prep Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly supports the 'Internship Evaluation Opportunity' perk by translating raw CP stats into recruiter-ready engineering capability profiles.
